name: GhostCard
description: Composable surface with header, content, and footer parts. Optional spotlight composes useGhostInteractiveSurface on data-interactive-state.

props.name: as
props.description: Root element. Use `a` only when the whole card navigates without nested controls.

props.name: effects
props.description: Ambient spotlight recipes. Empty list keeps the card inert.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Optional bottom region for actions on static roots.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: Root element after mount; null before mount.

parts.name: glow
parts.description: Decorative spotlight layer when effects includes spotlight.

states.name: off
states.description: Spotlight inactive (empty effects, reduced motion, or coarse pointer).

states.name: idle
states.description: Spotlight capable but pointer outside the host.

states.name: tracking
states.description: Pointer over the host; glow follows CSS variables.

keyboard.Tab: Moves through focusable descendants on static roots. `a`/`button` roots are a single tab stop.
